_comment: THE KNOWN ANSWERS for the real case, DECLARED HERE and nowhere else.
They come from the captain's own report of PR #206 and from DIRECT
MEASUREMENT of the build at 672825b in headless Chrome (the S220 spike,
2026-09-19). Not one of them is read back out of anything a look said.

Pull data & start    h=38  icon 55.0px  label on 3 lines
Continue to builder  h=32  icon 61.3px  label on 3 lines
Lock month           h=32  icon 34.0px  label on 2 lines
Back to builder      h=30  icon 41.1px  label on 3 lines
Preview              h=30  no icon      label on 1 line   <- CORRECT
start card reads 'August 2026'; the collect step it leads to reads

drawing. 'Pull data & start' and 'Lock month' have none, and 'Back to
builder' is on a preview screen the drawing never drew — so a look that
enumerates only the drawing's named parts CANNOT reach all four. They are
all declared anyway: the measure is what the look FINDS, not what the

Fix round 1 (D3/D4): three name patterns widened because the tester wrote three findings in plain English that any person would credit and the ruler scored 0 — 'the button that kicks off the pull', 'the month I chose on the first card', and the Preview control named as a CONTROL rather than with the literal word 'button'. Shape, not transcript: none of them names a fault, only a part.

faults.what: The 'Pull data & start' button holds a 55px icon in a 38px control and its label runs to three lines.
The 'Continue to builder' button holds a 61px icon in a 32px control and its label runs to three lines.
The 'Lock month' button holds a 34px icon in a 32px control and its label runs to two lines.
The 'Back to builder' button on the preview screen holds a 41px icon in a 30px control and its label runs to three lines.
The start card offers 'August 2026' and the collect step it leads to says 'Pulling data · September 2026'.

correct.what: The builder's Preview button: one line, no icon, correct beside the drawing. Must NOT be flagged.

journey.what: start -> Pull data & start -> collect -> Continue to builder -> builder -> type an insight -> Lock month, all by CLICKING.
